approvedConcept: A · 贴贴分身：奶白自己、淡紫数字分身、草莓发夹
concept:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original macOS/Windows desktop application icon concept for the brand "zaizai" (Chinese nickname 崽崽). Generate one square image, one icon only.
Brand meaning: "我在这里，也在你身边。" A digital version of oneself, quiet reassuring presence, self-companionship when alone, closeness across distance, and a cute character with independent IP potential.
Design direction A — "贴贴分身": Invent an original small soft creature with a highly memorable simple silhouette, like a plump rounded pebble child with a small asymmetric double-lobed crown, two expressive tiny dark oval eyes, a very subtle friendly smile, and two tiny integrated hugging arms. Show one ivory creature and its slightly smaller muted lilac digital twin leaning closely into its side, overlapping into one compact inseparable hugging emblem. The twin should visibly share the same species and face; their relationship reads as "another me is right here". Give the main creature a small warm peach circular presence light integrated on the upper side of its head, not a notification badge. No accessories. Both creatures together form a distinctive compact silhouette that is unmistakable at 32 pixels.
Art direction: exceptionally refined contemporary character brand design, cute, comforting, quietly confident and emotionally warm, sophisticated simplicity. Smooth matte porcelain / very soft clay volume with restrained shading and clean precise edges; avoid toy photography and furry textures. Warm apricot/coral rounded-square icon tile, ivory and lilac characters, deep cocoa eyes. Balanced macOS icon composition with generous safe margins. One large icon fills about 86% of the square image; rounded tile corners with a plain warm off-white surround and subtle clean grounding shadow. Large bold shapes, minimal parts.
Constraints: a finished app icon concept, straight-on orthographic view, no perspective, no icon grid, no phones, no desktop mockup, no text, no lettering, no slogan, no watermark. Entire symbol centered with all edges visible. Original character, no recognizable existing mascot. Do not add hearts, stars, floating particles or tiny decorative details.
strawberryEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the referenced zaizai application icon, concept A, showing an ivory creature and its pale lavender digital twin leaning together on a warm coral rounded-square tile.
Make exactly one local change: add a cute small strawberry hair clip to the pale lavender character on the RIGHT. Attach the clip naturally at the upper right side of its head, just below its smaller right crown bump. The accessory is a single small plump red/pink strawberry with a little green leafy cap and a few tiny cream seeds, rendered in the same smooth matte soft clay/porcelain 2.5D style, with a subtle contact shadow so it reads as a hair clip attached to the character. Make it clear and recognizable but small, about the size of one eye to one-and-a-half eye widths.
Preserve everything else: the original composition, both characters' exact silhouettes, relative sizes, poses, faces, eye and mouth positions, ivory and lavender body colors, orange presence spot on the ivory character, coral background tile, off-white surround, lighting, texture, shading, framing and image dimensions. Keep the two characters hugging closely. Do not add hair, clothing, other accessories, text, logos or decoration. The only new object is this strawberry hair clip.

The only change: remove the off-white presentation canvas OUTSIDE the coral rounded-square tile, including the cast shadow on that presentation canvas, and replace only that exterior with genuine transparent pixels. Preserve the tile itself opaque and preserve the original tile size, rounded corners and safe margin, all character silhouettes, faces, colors, strawberry hair clip, lighting, interior shadows, material, scale, positions, crop and framing. Do not crop or zoom. No design change, no new outline, no repainting or reinterpretation. Keep it a square RGBA PNG with actual alpha transparency outside the tile.
